## Summary
The scheduled **Live External Integration** run on 2026-08-17 (run 32000764439, job "jira DC harness smoke (real Jira Data Center, ephemeral)") failed
`tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_multi_project_rehearsal.py::test_unknown_project_fails_closed`
with:

```
E   Failed: DID NOT RAISE RebarError
```

The scenario maps an unknown project key — `rebar.bridge_projects_set(unknown, ["rebar-ghost"], repo_root=str(work))` — and then previews/syncs it, expecting the bridge to **fail closed** (RAISE `RebarError`) rather than silently no-op on an unknown mapped key. Against the live DC instance it did **not** raise.

## Regression window
This is a NEW regression, not a long-standing failure:
- 2026-08-15 run 31879125045 (jira DC job 94999114642): **73 passed, 1 xfailed, 0 failed**.
- 2026-08-17 run 32000764439: **2 failed, 71 passed, 1 xfailed** — this test is one of the two new failures.

So a change landed between 2026-08-15 and 2026-08-17 that broke the fail-closed guard for an unknown bridge-project key. Candidate areas to bisect: `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/projects_store.py` (`resolve_project` / `compute_snapshot`), `bridge_projects_set`, and the multi-project preview/sync path (cf. related bug 3b87 `resolve_project` tri-state collapse, and epic 0e68 / story 368f which delivered this behavior).

## Impact
The multi-project bridge's fail-closed safety guarantee is not holding against a real Jira DC instance: an unknown mapped project key produces a silent empty fetch/sync instead of an error. Correctness/safety of the many-to-many bridge.

## The regression escaped because only a LIVE test covered it
Per triage guidance: a live-external regression must be reproducible by a NON-external test so CI catches it without the (slow, credentialed) live suite. Today the only coverage is the live DC rehearsal.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A **RED** non-external test (unit or fake-transport integration, no live DC/creds) reproduces the regression: setting an unknown bridge-project mapping and running preview/sync RAISES `RebarError` (fail-closed) — asserted to FAIL against current `main` before the fix.
- [x] Root cause identified (the change between 2026-08-15 and 2026-08-17 that dropped the fail-closed behavior) and fixed so an unknown mapped project key fails closed.
- [x] The new non-external test passes after the fix.
- [x] The live rehearsal `test_unknown_project_fails_closed` passes in the next Live External Integration run. [operator-attested]

## Evidence
- Failing run: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/32000764439 (job: jira DC harness smoke)
- Test: `tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_multi_project_rehearsal.py::test_unknown_project_fails_closed`
- Delivered by story 368f (gasolinic-microbian-puffin), epic 0e68 (outrageous-uncultured-wildebeast).
